description: Changes an existing drive — its goal, a constraint, a failure condition, a scenario, its plays or their order, the questions it asks first, its checker or runner setting, or how it ends — by editing the drive's ICE and rebuilding it, so the drive always matches its intent. Companion to drive-creator (which builds new drives). Use when the user wants to edit, change, update or fix a drive — or says "edit the drive", "add a play to Kickoff", "the drive needs a new question", "drive-editor", or "rebuild the drive after I changed its ICE".
